term.label: Watson_strand

definition.text: An absolute reference to the strand. When a chromosome has p and q arms, the Watson strand is the strand whose 5'-end is on the short arm of the chromosome. Of note, the term 'plus strand' is typically based on a reference sequence where it's preferred for the plus strand to be the Watson strand, but might not be and 'plus strand' is therefore not an exact synonym.

comments: Added as per GitHub Issue Request #419 (https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/SO-Ontologies/issues/419)
